title: Mystic Neuron Snow Globe
description: A glowing glass snow globe contains a surreal landscape with a silhouetted woman standing before a large red moon. Inside, vibrant yellow, blue, pink and purple branching structures resembling neurons or lightning spread across the scene from a central glowing base.
prompt: A surreal glass snow globe containing a dreamlike landscape with a silhouetted woman in a long dress standing before a glowing red moon. Inside the globe, colorful glowing neural branches in yellow, blue, pink and purple grow like lightning or trees from a bright base, set against a misty field with bare trees under a starry twilight sky, painted in a vibrant fantasy style.
